entity.name: Magisterial District Court 03-2-11
entity.jurisdiction: Civil and criminal matters under MDJ jurisdiction

findings.title: Inadequate Arrest Warrant Documentation
findings.description: Court failed to maintain complete arrest warrant documentation. 27% of sampled warrants lacked required supporting documents including probable cause affidavits.
findings.managementResponse: Working with AOPC on new documentation system

findings.title: Case Disposition Delays
findings.description: 15% of cases exceeded statutory time limits for disposition without documented continuances.
findings.recommendation: Implement case aging report review weekly

findings.title: Record Retention Schedule Non-Compliance
findings.description: Some records retained beyond required period causing storage issues; others disposed of before retention period expired.
findings.recommendation: Train staff on current retention schedules

findings.title: Arrest Warrant Procedure Deficiencies
findings.description: First occurrence - 21% of warrants sampled had documentation gaps

controllerFlags.description: Recurring arrest warrant documentation failures - consecutive audit findings 2023 and 2024
controllerFlags.requiredAction: Controller review and corrective action plan oversight
